card.name: Start of a surname after a first name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a surname that is split into several pieces, right after a given name or a title and name. It appears in author lists, citations and names in running text.

modes.example: Malemba Nkulu, Kabala, Butombe, Songwe, and<< Tw>>ite-Mwanza.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a rare proper name with an unusual word piece, and away from the word "effective".
card.plain: It marks the start of an unusual surname that comes right after a first name.
